money_path_or_issue: Employer, government, or member payment -> UnitedHealthcare or Optum -> claims, care, pharmacy, and data workflow -> medical cost and expenses -> operating earnings -> operating cash flow.
current_evidence: Revenue, earnings from operations, net margin, adjusted EPS, guidance, and expected operating cash flow are visible.
missing_proof: Medical care ratio, claims payable, reserve development, receivables, segment revenue/margin, pharmacy economics, and operating cash-flow bridge.

money_path_or_issue: Employer, plan sponsor, government, or member payment -> Cigna Healthcare or Evernorth -> benefits, claims, pharmacy services, and specialty routing -> adjusted operating income -> cash only if claims, receivables, and pharmacy working capital convert.
current_evidence: Revenue growth, total revenues, net income, adjusted income, leverage context, and raised outlook are visible.
missing_proof: Segment revenue/margin, premium revenue, pharmacy-service revenue, medical-care ratio, claims payable, receivables, retention, specialty pharmacy economics, operating cash flow, and free cash flow.

money_path_or_issue: Kidney-failure patient need -> scheduled dialysis treatment -> staffed center or kidney-care program -> payer reimbursement -> operating cash only if reimbursement, labor, utilization, and collections hold.
current_evidence: Revenue, operating income, operating cash flow, treatments per day, risk-based patient count, and annualized medical spend are visible.
missing_proof: Revenue per treatment, patient care cost per treatment, payer mix, utilization, labor cost, receivables, free cash flow, debt, risk-contract margin, and quality metrics.

money_path_or_issue: Aging, disability, chronic illness, or hospice need -> authorized home-care service -> caregiver or clinician visit -> documented billing -> payer reimbursement -> cash only if labor, rates, compliance, and collections work.
current_evidence: Revenue, net income, adjusted EBITDA, operating cash flow, and personal-care/hospice/home-health mix are visible.
missing_proof: Billable hours, visit volume, reimbursement rates, caregiver hiring and retention, wage pass-through, payer mix, receivables, branch density, acquisition economics, free cash flow, and quality metrics.

money_path_or_issue: Therapy need -> physician referral or order -> payer authorization -> specialty pharmacy and infusion coordination -> drug and supplies -> nurse or infusion-site administration -> reimbursement -> cash only if drug cost, receivables, nurse capacity, and working capital hold.
current_evidence: Net revenue, revenue growth, GAAP net income, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EPS, liquidity context, and upward guidance are visible.
missing_proof: Therapy category revenue, referral volume, payer mix, drug reimbursement, gross margin, nurse capacity, receivables, inventory, working capital, free cash flow, concentration, adherence, safety, and outcomes.

money_path_or_issue: The first pass proves scale and company-level operating economics, not claim-level cash movement.
current_evidence: FY2025 revenue 447.6B USD; FY2025 operating earnings 19.0B USD; FY2025 net margin 2.7%; FY2025 adjusted EPS 16.35 USD; Q1/Q2 2026 revenue and operating earnings; 2026 adjusted EPS guidance; expected operating cash flow about 24.0B USD.
missing_proof: Tie premiums, medical costs, claims payable, receivables, Optum economics, and operating cash flow together.

money_path_or_issue: The first pass proves benefits/PBM scale and earnings, not affordability or transparent pharmacy economics.
current_evidence: FY2025 revenue growth 11%; FY2025 total revenues 274.9B USD; shareholders net income 6.0B USD; adjusted income from operations 8.0B USD; Q1/Q2 2026 revenues above 68B USD; Q1/Q2 adjusted income above 2B USD; debt-to-capitalization; raised outlook.
missing_proof: Tie Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth revenue/margin, premium revenue, pharmacy-service revenue, medical care ratio, claims, receivables, and cash flow.

money_path_or_issue: The first pass proves recurring treatment density and company-level cash flow, not site-level treatment economics.
current_evidence: FY2025 revenue 13.643B USD; operating income 2.044B USD; Q4 operating cash flow 541M USD; Q1/Q2 revenue, operating income, operating cash flow; Q1 treatments per day 91,650; Q2 treatments per day 92,649; 64,900 risk-based patients; 5.8B USD annualized medical spend.
missing_proof: Tie treatments, revenue per treatment, patient care cost, payer mix, receivables, free cash flow, and quality metrics.

money_path_or_issue: The first pass proves home-care platform scale and operating economics, not billable-hour collection or caregiver adequacy.
current_evidence: FY2025 revenue 1.42B USD; FY2025 net income 95.9M USD; FY2025 adjusted EBITDA 180.0M USD; Q4/Q1/Q2 revenue, profit, adjusted EBITDA, operating cash flow; Q2 mix 78.4% personal care, 17.0% hospice, 4.6% home health.
missing_proof: Tie billable hours, caregiver labor, reimbursement rates, wage pass-through, payer mix, receivables, branch density, and free cash flow.

money_path_or_issue: The first pass proves alternate-site infusion scale and adjusted earnings, not therapy-level cash conversion.
current_evidence: Q4 2025 net revenue 1.4654B USD; Q4 revenue growth 8.8%; strong cash-generation setup; Q1 net revenue 1.3507B USD; Q1 GAAP net income 45.3M USD; Q1 adjusted EBITDA 104.8M USD; Q2 net revenue 1.442B USD; Q2 GAAP net income 53.9M USD; Q2 adjusted EBITDA 117.5M USD; upward guidance.
missing_proof: Tie therapy mix, referral volume, payer authorization, drug reimbursement, inventory, receivables, working capital, and free cash flow.

money_path_or_issue: Claims and pharmacy routing need cash proof before strong conclusions.
current_evidence: Company-level revenue and cash-flow guidance are not enough.
missing_proof: Premium receivables, claims payable, reserve development, medical care ratio, Optum revenue/margin, pharmacy economics, and actual operating cash-flow reconciliation.

money_path_or_issue: PBM and benefits scale need segment and working-capital proof before strong conclusions.
current_evidence: Adjusted income and revenue scale are not enough.
missing_proof: Cigna Healthcare margin, Evernorth margin, premium revenue, pharmacy-service revenue, medical care ratio, claims payable, receivables, retention, specialty pharmacy economics, and free cash flow.

money_path_or_issue: Treatment density needs unit economics and collection proof before strong conclusions.
current_evidence: Treatments per day and operating cash flow are not enough.
missing_proof: Revenue per treatment, patient care cost per treatment, payer mix, center utilization, home dialysis share, receivables, debt, risk-contract margin, and quality/outcome data.

money_path_or_issue: Home-care growth needs labor, rate, and service-line collection proof before strong conclusions.
current_evidence: Revenue, adjusted EBITDA, and operating cash flow are not enough.
missing_proof: Billable hours, visit volume, caregiver hiring, retention, wage pass-through, reimbursement rates, payer mix, branch density, acquisition economics, receivables, free cash flow, and compliance/outcome metrics.

money_path_or_issue: Infusion growth needs therapy, drug-cost, and working-capital proof before strong conclusions.
current_evidence: Net revenue, adjusted EBITDA, and guidance are not enough.
missing_proof: Therapy revenue, referral volume, active patients, payer mix, drug reimbursement, gross margin, nurse capacity, inventory, receivables, free cash flow, concentration, adherence, safety, and outcomes.
